title: ⚡ Tech & Coding Superstars
description: Test your knowledge of programming, web tech, AI, and computing history!

questions.question: Which language is primarily used for structuring modern web pages?
questions.explanation: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) provides the fundamental structure of all web documents.

questions.question: What does 'API' stand for in software development?
questions.explanation: API stands for Application Programming Interface, allowing different apps to communicate.

questions.question: Which company originally created JavaScript in just 10 days in 1995?
questions.explanation: Brendan Eich created JavaScript at Netscape in May 1995.

questions.question: In Git, what command creates a new branch and switches to it in one step?
questions.explanation: 'git checkout -b <name>' or 'git switch -c <name>' creates and checks out a new branch.

questions.question: What does HTTP status code 404 signify?
questions.explanation: HTTP 404 indicates the requested server resource was not found.

title: 🚀 Science & Cosmic Wonders
description: Embark on a tour of the cosmos, physics, astronomy, and planetary mysteries!

questions.question: What is the closest planet to the Sun in our Solar System?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the closest planet to the Sun, orbiting at an average distance of ~58 million km.

questions.question: What is the speed of light in a vacuum (approximately)?
questions.explanation: Light travels at roughly 299,792 km/second in a vacuum.

questions.question: Which gas makes up roughly 78% of Earth's atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up ~78%, Oxygen is ~21%, and other gases comprise the remaining 1%.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse organelle of the biological cell?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions.

title: 🌍 Mega World Trivia
description: A high-energy battle of geography, world records, and fun facts!

questions.question: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo is the bustling capital of Japan and one of the world's most populous metropolitan areas.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on planet Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean on Earth, covering more than 30% of Earth's surface.

questions.question: How many players are on the field for one team in a standard soccer match?
questions.explanation: Each soccer team consists of 11 players on the field, including the goalkeeper.
